messages.text:
I can’t send a refund to your sister’s bank account. Refunds can only go to the order’s original payment, and I can’t redirect one to another account—even with your permission. (refund-policy/v2/payment)

Your returned Bluetooth speaker is eligible for a refund of **BRL 149.65** to the original payment. If you’d like to proceed on that basis, let me know and I can create the proposal for you to confirm. (refund-policy/v2/amount)
